Dubai Culture and Arts Authority (Dubai Culture) celebrates the success of the cultural tour it organised in Italy for participants in the ‘Empowering Emirati Musicians Programme,’ supported through the Dubai Cultural Grant. The initiative reflects the Authority's commitment to empowering local musical talent, enabling participants to refine their skills and engage with international experiences. During the tour, 20 participants in the programme, organised by Dubai Culture in partnership with House of Pianos, presented their first concert at Steinway & Sons Milan, followed by a second performance at Academia Cremonensis in Cremona.
